$comment: Kit performance budgets. Measured baseline 2026-10-12 (raw/gzip bytes): worker entry 2551/1219; server JS total (22 files, no sourcemaps) 962157/258300 — dominated by the Hono catch-all bundle (chunks/hono.js 433009); client JS total (11 files) 100252/39302; client CSS total (1 file) 2402/763. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B), the repository x1.25 rule from ci/bundle-budget.json. Client/server hashed-asset groups are budgeted as totals plus a file-count cap, so a new chunk fails closed instead of escaping enforcement. Startup.maxMs (60s, the same cold-start bound as ci/kit-worker-e2e.mjs's listen) is enforced as the Kit webServer readiness timeout in playwright.kit-parity.config.ts; the parity spec additionally records warm first-200 latency as a report annotation under a 10s liveness bound. Raising a ceiling needs an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget to make CI green. 2026-10-13 decision (join landing): main measures 31 server files and the /join route adds 5 (2 page entries + 1 SvelteKit node + Vite re-partitioning the shared 437k Hono catch-all into chunks/src.js and splitting chunks/kit-session.js for the flash/widget load) for 36 total; byte totals still fit with ~15% margin (raw 1014543, gzip 275405, branch raw below main's 1025212), so only the file-count cap moves, 32 to 45 (36 x1.25, the repository rule), preserving fail-closed for unexpected chunks. 2026-10-13 decision (profile reads): two new disabled-manifest routes (/profile, /members/:user) sharing the ProfileView chunk add 4 server page entries + 2 nodes + the ProfileView server chunk (54 server files; byte totals still fit with ~13% raw / ~10% gzip margin, so only the file-count cap moves, 45 to 68 = 54 x1.25 rounded up) and 2 client nodes + profile client chunks (21 files, raw 132264, gzip 53115, so client caps move per the x1.25 rule to 165376 raw / 66560 gzip / 27 files), preserving fail-closed for unexpected chunks.
